name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ani_decoder, descriptor=set_target_buffer). No address residue. Accurately reflects purpose: stores the decoder's target-buffer parameters into globals before each frame decode.
purpose: Stores the ANI.DAT frame-decoder target-buffer parameters (width, dst_buf, src_buf) into three adjacent globals that the chunk handlers read.
logic_summary: EBP frame, no __CHK. Three straight stores: word param_1 -> 0x52760 (target_width), dword param_2 -> 0x52762 (dst_buf), dword param_3 -> 0x52766 (src_buf). Returns void. Disassembly (MOV [0x52760],AX / MOV [0x52762],EAX / MOV [0x52766],EAX) matches source exactly.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer(uint16 width, uint32 dst_buf, uint32 src_buf)

params.name: width
params.semantics: Per-chunk output byte length stored to target_width @ 0x52760. Consumed by row chunk handlers as REP STOSD/MEMSET/MEMCPY count and as the RLE/copy total-output target (write exactly width bytes). Caller fd2_play_ani_file_animation_sequence passes 64000 (full 320x200 mode13h framebuffer), so in this game it is the full-frame chunk length rather than a 320 row stride.
params.reason: Matches the consumed global's domain name (target_width); not address residue; descriptive enough. Renaming the param would not change the symbol value semantics; consistent with handler usage.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination linear address stored to dst_buf @ 0x52762. Used by row/sparse chunk handlers as the destination base pointer (REP STOSD / memcpy / sparse base[offset]). Caller passes 0xA0000 (VGA mode13h framebuffer).
params.reason: Clear, matches consumed global name; no address residue.

params.name: src_buf
params.semantics: Palette-area / source base address stored to src_buf @ 0x52766. Used by the palette chunk handlers as the 768-byte palette write base. Caller passes the malloc(0x300) scratch buffer.
params.reason: Matches consumed global name; no address residue. (Acts as palette-area base, not a true source stream pointer, but the established global name is src_buf; consistency preserved.)

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect setter.

comment_original_issue: Source comment block above the function was a bare divider with only the address; it did not describe what the setter stores or its role per frame.
notes: Ghidra plate is accurate and consistent with refined understanding (correctly describes the three stores + consumers); left unchanged. Minor terminology nuance: plate and the width global's own comment call width a 'row stride', but the caller passes 64000 so it acts as a full-frame per-chunk output length; the width global's comment is a separate symbol (its own refine task) and was not edited here per single-symbol scope. Only the setter function's own comment block (src) was augmented.
